'Welcome competition including Starlink': Reliance reacts to Musk's comments
articles.description: Reliance Industries has welcomed the entry of Elon Musk's Starlink into the Indian satellite communications market. The company clarified that it has never feared competition and is also awaiting clearances for its satellite services. Musk has alleged that Reliance benefits from monopolistic practices and has questioned regulatory barriers. The Indian government has stated that all companies must comply with existing laws and security requirements.

articles.title: 'I can always talk to you like this': On cam, IAS officer abuses woman during meeting
articles.description: Kumar Rajeev Ranjan, an IAS officer, reportedly insulted a subordinate female officer during a video meeting. This incident has sparked widespread condemnation from various political parties in Jammu and Kashmir. Ranjan allegedly used derogatory language and threatened to get the officer suspended. While the labour department claimed the video is fabricated, JKAS officers assert its authenticity. Numerous calls for inquiry and action against Ranjan have been made following this incident.

articles.title: ‘Series in India brings nothing to Windies’: Cricket’s revenue model sparks debate
articles.description: Cricket West Indies CEO Chris Dehring criticised the bilateral revenue model, saying the board earns nothing when the team tours India, despite series potentially generating $20–30 million. He traced the problem to a 1997 ICC decision allowing hosts to retain broadcasting revenue. Dehring blamed the system for West Indies’ financial struggles, which have led to player pay cuts and suspended domestic competitions.

articles.title: Stock market today: BSE Sensex tumbles 200 points, NSE Nifty50 opens below 23,000
articles.full_text: Equity markets closed sharply higher on Thursday, with Sensex and Nifty50 recording their biggest single-day gains in four months. BSE Sensex surged 1,533.72 points, or 2.11%, to settle at 74,315.61, while NSE Nifty50 advanced 374.65 points, or 1.66%, to close at 22,997.35. The gains came even as major Asian markets faced heavy selling pressure amid concerns over stretched valuations of artificial intelligence companies and higher US inflation. According to Vinod Nair, head of research at Geojit Investments, the global sell-off in technology-heavy markets improved India's relative appeal and encouraged buying in domestic large-cap technology stocks, private financial companies and defensive stocks.

articles.title: Five Indiana engineering students built a 12-hour wearable that helps visually impaired users detect obstacles beyond a cane or guide dog
articles.description: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback. With a remarkable twelve-hour battery life on a single charge, this device empowers users with greater independence. The project's goal is to enhance the day-to-day experiences of those with vision impairments.

Yash shares his excitement working with AR Rahman in 'Ramayana'
articles.description: At a recent event, Yash, the actor portraying Ravana, shared his enthusiasm for collaborating with renowned composer AR Rahman. Reflecting on his childhood memories of dancing to Rahman's melodies, Yash believes this partnership adds a unique touch to the upcoming film 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend.' Additionally, the involvement of iconic composer Hans Zimmer showcases a fusion of musical styles aimed at presenting India's rich culture to a global audience.

articles.title: 'Ramayana' advance booking crosses USD 100K in US
articles.description: Advance bookings for 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend' have commenced and surpassed USD 100,000 in ticket sales. The film is set to release worldwide on November 5, with strong demand evident in the US market. Fandango is offering discounts on IMAX tickets for the movie, which aims to provide an immersive cinematic experience. Trade predictions suggest it may achieve significant box office revenues upon release.
